body.name: \(\mathcal P_4\)
body.construction: \(\mathcal P_4:=\{P:P\text{ satisfies consistency, conditional exchangeability, conditional independent censoring, the displayed density and treatment-overlap bands, the event-hazard band, the exact quadratic censoring factorization with its residual envelope and survival shape, and the three radius-}20\text{ Hölder conditions for every }a\in\{0,1\}\}\).
